base_analysis.semantic_identity: Online language curriculum hero showing a coherent path from lessons to confident communication
base_analysis.subject_identity_requirements: NONE - no specific person identity required; reference person identity must not transfer

observations.description: A man in a black suit faces forward with his right hand extended in a presenting gesture toward a floating interface
A curved carousel of five framed panels floats across the lower third, creating a horizontal progression with slight arc
Each panel contains distinct product imagery: a fashion portrait, a burger, a perfume bottle in a forest setting, a skincare serum, and a dark cosmetic bottle
Green neon light outlines the carousel panels and technical UI elements; rim lighting separates the subject from the dark background
Dark background with green grid lines, technical markings, barcode elements, and floating geometric shapes
Layered depth created by the foreground carousel plane, midground subject, and background technical environment with atmospheric haze
Minimal text in upper left corner; technical markings and barcode-like elements on right edge

reference_dna.primary: modular carousel progression with presenting human guide
reference_dna.secondary: layered depth structure and controlled rim lighting
reference_dna.supporting: precise information spacing, atmospheric haze, neon framing
reference_dna.incidental: green sci-fi color palette, technical UI decorations, specific product identities

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: A curved or modular progression of specific language lesson artifacts (e.g., vocabulary cards, grammar modules, conversation scenarios) arranged to show the learning journey from beginner to confident communication
design_decision_map.rationale: The curved carousel creates a visual path and modular progression that maps to curriculum stages. Cards must be specific to language learning content and grouped by skill level or topic to avoid generic dashboard interchangeability.

cross_category_adaptation.literal_object: holographic product carousel with five framed panels
cross_category_adaptation.visual_function: modular progression display presenting a curated sequence of items
cross_category_adaptation.material_language: glowing neon borders, transparent glass panels, floating holographic interface
cross_category_adaptation.equivalent_adaptation: modular lesson artifact cards arranged in a curved or linear progression, framed by clean borders or subtle depth, representing the journey from lessons to confident communication; content includes specific vocabulary sets, grammar modules, or conversation scenarios
cross_category_adaptation.target_category_coherence: Language curricula are inherently modular and progressive; showing specific lesson artifacts in a sequence directly communicates the learning path. This avoids generic dashboard decoration by ensuring each card has specific curriculum content and logical grouping.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: A learner or instructor figure with a presenting/guiding gesture toward the curriculum path, creating human connection and narrative invitation
design_decision_map.rationale: The presenting gesture establishes a guide role and directs viewer attention into the learning journey. The specific person identity is discarded; the gesture role is adapted to an education-appropriate figure.

The green neon sci-fi aesthetic and technical UI decorations (barcodes, satellites, grid lines) conflict with the professional educational context and risk generic technology appearance. These are replaced with target-native learning environment cues.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Layered depth structure with foreground learning artifacts, midground hero/subject, and background learning environment
design_decision_map.rationale: The three-plane depth system creates spatial hierarchy and immersion. This relational structure transfers directly to the educational context.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Controlled portrait or environmental lighting that separates the subject and highlights key learning artifacts without sci-fi connotations
design_decision_map.rationale: The rim lighting and contrast create hierarchy and focus. This lighting logic is adapted to a professional educational setting with warm or neutral light appropriate to learning.
Source text and technical markings are not transferred. Typography will be target-owned and specific to the curriculum message.

conflicts.description: Reference displays specific product cards (fragrance, skincare, food, fashion) and green energy treatment, which are explicitly forbidden by user constraints.
involved_constraints: reference person identity must not become target identity
conflicts.translator_position: Discard all product-specific cards and green sci-fi aesthetic; adapt only the modular carousel structure and presenting gesture mechanism.

conflicts.description: Reference uses a sci-fi/cyberpunk aesthetic with green neon and technical UI that conflicts with the professional educational context and risks generic technology appearance.
conflicts.translator_position: Discard the sci-fi aesthetic and replace with target-native educational environment cues while preserving the modular information structure.

conflicts.description: Reference contains a recognizable person whose identity must not transfer to the target.
involved_constraints: reference person identity must not become target identity
conflicts.translator_position: Discard the specific person; retain only the presenting gesture role and adapt to an education-appropriate figure.

non_negotiable_anchors.function: Visualize a learning journey with distinct stages or modules
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: This is the primary signature mechanism showing progression and modular content organization

non_negotiable_anchors.function: Create human connection and direct viewer attention into the learning path
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: Establishes narrative invitation and authority without requiring the specific reference person

non_negotiable_anchors.function: Organize information into specific, non-interchangeable learning artifacts
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: Cards must remain specific to language learning content to avoid dashboard overload and generic interchangeability

non_negotiable_anchors.function: Create spatial hierarchy between learning artifacts, subject, and environment
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: Depth planes organize complexity and guide attention

flexible_areas.rationale: The green sci-fi palette is discarded; target may use warm, cool, or neutral educational lighting appropriate to the learning context
The technical sci-fi background is replaced with target-native learning environments (classroom, study, travel, professional settings)
The reference person is excluded; any appropriate learner, instructor, or abstract hero may be used
The five product cards become language lesson artifacts; count and specific content are target decisions as long as they remain specific and grouped
All sci-fi UI elements (barcodes, satellites, geometric shapes) are discarded; target may use minimal interface cues only if they serve the curriculum narrative

risks.description: Cards become generic dashboard decoration rather than specific learning artifacts
risks.mitigation: Ensure each card contains specific, verified curriculum content (e.g., actual lesson titles, skill levels, or language scenarios) with clear grouping logic; avoid fake metrics or interchangeable panels.

risks.description: Generic technology aesthetic persists despite discard of sci-fi elements
risks.mitigation: Replace green neon and technical UI with target-native educational environment cues; use motivated lighting from windows, screens, or environmental sources rather than automatic glow.

risks.description: Subject identity leakage from reference person
risks.mitigation: Use a different person or abstract hero; do not replicate the reference subject's likeness, styling, or pose exactly.

risks.description: Over-transfer of reference composition leads to target blindness
risks.mitigation: Prioritize the target's communication goal (progress from lessons to confident communication) over preserving the reference's exact carousel shape or sci-fi atmosphere.

open_questions.question: Should the curriculum hero feature a specific learner/instructor persona, or an abstract product/interface hero?

provenance.notes: Analysis of live_ref_card_carousel for online language curriculum hero. Cross-category translation from product carousel to educational artifacts.

confidence.rationale: Reference image is clear and multimodal access is confirmed. Functional mechanisms (modular progression, presenting gesture, layered depth) are identifiable and transferable with clear adaptation paths. Cross-category translation is well-defined.

what_must_survive: Modular progression logic showing a learning journey
Human guide or presenter figure creating narrative invitation
Layered depth structure (foreground artifacts, midground hero, background environment)
what_should_survive: Controlled lighting hierarchy separating subject and artifacts
Curved or modular composition creating visual flow
Atmospheric depth through haze or environmental separation
what_can_change: Carousel exact shape (may adapt to target format)
key_conflicts: Reference sci-fi/tech aesthetic vs professional educational context
Reference product cards vs target learning artifacts
Reference person identity vs target identity protection
recommended_anchors: Curved modular carousel as learning path
creative_opportunities: Use real language lesson content on cards (vocabulary sets, grammar modules, cultural notes)
Adapt the presenting gesture to a diverse learner or instructor population
Replace sci-fi environment with authentic learning spaces (classroom, travel, professional settings)
Use the carousel concept to show progression from beginner to advanced levels
warnings: Avoid generic dashboard styling; cards must be specific and narrative
Avoid green neon and sci-fi UI elements that signal generic technology
Do not replicate the reference person's identity
Ensure cards are grouped by meaningful curriculum logic, not just arranged for aesthetics
